---
Peter \-- THANK YOU! You just helped send a BOOMING message to the Political Class that you will fight when called upon. I'm happy to report that the **$30,000 Legal Defense Fund goal was hit on Friday**. That's a big statement we just made. And I could not have done it without YOU! [](https://www.action4liberty.com/a4l_legal_fund?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=legal_fund_goal_hit&n=2) **It's no surprise that we are in the crosshairs of the Political Class. Last Tuesday's primary election victories show that the grassroots, conservative movement is growing and challenging the power structure.** And Tyrant wannabe Tim Walz has his allies in government, who know we are the group that threatens his hold on power the most. We REFUSE to let up on this battle though. Our liberty is too damn important. Action 4 Liberty is a thorn in the side of the Political Class, especially Tim Walz. We're the group that led the charge against his illegal Emergency Powers and unconstitutional mandates from the beginning. And because inflation is killing Minnesotans, we are leading the fight to GIVE BACK the entire budget surplus so we can afford these rising prices. But we face quite a hurdle. The corporate media and the Political Class are telling another narrative. They're going around selling their propaganda to the masses about how they're doing a great job "leading." That's why it's critically important that we get our message in front of millions of voters next week at the State Fair. That's our next big task. **We're going to expose the Tim Walz, Radical Leftwing Agenda:** **\- Crushing lockdowns and mandates** **\- Holding on to our surplus during inflation** **\- Out-of-control crime** If you want to help us with this important task, there's still time to volunteer for a six hour shift. All volunteers get a free ticket to the fair and an Action 4 Liberty t-shirt. Click this button and I'll have Bridget reach out to you immediately. | [](https://www.action4liberty.com/volunteer_state_fair_2022?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=legal_fund_goal_hit&n=3 "Volunteer") [Volunteer](https://www.action4liberty.com/volunteer_state_fair_2022?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=legal_fund_goal_hit&n=3)

Truly, as an outsider, non-establishment, non-professional-politician, I am at a certain disadvantage. I don't have the fancy endorsements, or the big money, or PACs spreading my message. But what I do have is more valuable. I have YOU, and the other voters of Rhode Island who want something different. They want someone with fresh ideas. Someone who understands what it is like to struggle. Someone who has the skills to get real improvements for the working and middle class families of this state because they have been doing that for their entire career. I believe I am that someone. Thank you for supporting and believing in me. With the primary only 1 month away, please consider a recurring contribution of $10 per week to support my campaign. You're financial support now is urgently needed and will be instrumental in getting us across the finish line - in first place! Your friend, \- Omar

name: Team Abrams
subject: Reimagining Georgia’s economy.

body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Our election comes down to this: Brian Kemp doesn’t care about Georgians
and we know because he advanced a dangerous and extreme agenda that hurts
families. The truth is his economic agenda has left too many behind.
Stacey Abrams has a plan for all Georgians to thrive and rise together.

He’s failed students by underfunding our educators and our schools.
He refused Medicaid expansion, costing Georgia 64,000 jobs and closing
rural hospitals.
His extreme abortion ban and gun laws have already cost Georgia’s economy
at least $50 million and put millions more at risk.

We have to replace Brian Kemp with Stacey Abrams if we ever want to move
Georgia forward. But Brian Kemp is going to use every dirty trick in the

Hi there, it’s me again.

I hate to bother you, but our FEC Mid-Quarter deadline is just a few hours
away and we’re still $18,000 short of our $300,000 goal.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/18829?t=1009&amount=25&akid=5019%2E3611125%2Eqk1TjH ]Before I go on, will you chip in $10, $25 or more right now so we can

decide Senate control?

I was born and raised in a blue-collar union family in Northeast Ohio. So
I grew up believing that if you worked hard, you’d be able to keep a roof
over your head, put food on the table, and provide a better future for
your children and their children, too.

But somewhere along the way, our country lost sight of how to make things
work for everyone. We ended up with an economy and a political system that
only work for the wealthy, while working-class folks are trying harder
than ever and falling even further behind.

Well, enough is enough.

I’m running for Senate to ensure that everyone can have a good-paying job,
quality health care they can afford, and the security of knowing they can
retire with dignity.

Unfortunately, Mitch McConnell and the GOP’s dark money fundraising
machine know this race will decide Senate control. So they’re doing
everything in their power to take me down and buy Ohio’s open Senate seat
for JD Vance.

That’s why I need your help.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/18829?t=1011&amount=25&akid=5019%2E3611125%2Eqk1TjH ]Will you chip in $10, $25, or whatever amount makes sense for your
budget, so I can defeat JD Vance and help Democrats expand our Senate
majority? I’m committed to putting Ohio first and cutting workers in on
the deal, but I’ll need your support.

body:
I never dreamt “Dr. Oz” and “Crudités” would trend nationally on Twitter- on my birthday- but here we are
#
Omg, Derek.
I never dreamt “Dr. Oz” and “Crudités” would trend nationally on Twitter (on my birthday), but here we are.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220815-sticker?refcode=em20220815-6870&refcode2=6870_434096_0lFtGo&akid=6870%2E434096%2E0lFtGo)
In a viral online video that’s all over the internet right now, Dr. Oz goes shopping for vegetables to make a “Crudité” for his wife.
I mean I guess that’s what they call it in Hollywood. **But here in PA we just call that a... veggie tray.**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220815-sticker?refcode=em20220815-6870&refcode2=6870_434096_0lFtGo&akid=6870%2E434096%2E0lFtGo)
Also, it was incredibly obvious that this was Dr. Oz’s first time stepping inside a Redner’s Market — or as he referred to it, “Wegners” 🙄 (there are a few Wegmans near his home in New Jersey).
**So, to honor Dr. Oz’s love for Crudité (and also because it’s my birthday) we’re launching this NEW limited edition sticker.**
[****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220815-sticker?refcode=em20220815-6870&refcode2=6870_434096_0lFtGo&akid=6870%2E434096%2E0lFtGo)
_This hilarious sticker is all yours if you make a donation of any amount to our campaign today._
[**_Most people are donating $5 or more. Will you make a contribution of any amount in exchange for our brand new crudité sticker? Chip in any amount right now to claim your sticker today._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220815-sticker?refcode=em20220815-6870&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6870_434096_0lFtGo&akid=6870%2E434096%2E0lFtGo)
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220815-sticker?refcode=em20220815-6870&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6870_434096_0lFtGo&akid=6870%2E434096%2E0lFtGo)**
“Let Them eat Crudité.” Because there’s nothing more out of touch than calling a veggie tray some French word.
Thanks,
❤️ John
P.S. I gotta mention our mid-month fundraising deadline, which is at midnight tonight. Your donation today gets you a sticker AND helps me reach our fundraising goal. **[What do you say, will you make a donation of any amount to claim your crudité sticker today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220815-sticker?refcode=em20220815-6870&refcode2=6870_434096_0lFtGo&akid=6870%2E434096%2E0lFtGo)**

In a viral online video that’s all over the internet right now, Dr. Oz goes shopping for vegetables to make a “Crudité” for his wife. I mean I guess that’s what they call it in Hollywood. But here in PA we just call that a... veggie tray. Also, it was incredibly obvious that this was Dr. Oz’s first time stepping inside a Redner’s Market — or as he referred to it, “Wegners” 🙄 (there are a few Wegmans near his home in New Jersey). So, to honor Dr. Oz’s love for Crudité (and also because it’s my birthday) we’re launching this NEW limited edition sticker. This hilarious sticker is all yours if you make a donation of any amount to our campaign today. “Let Them eat Crudité.” Because there’s nothing more out of touch than calling a veggie tray some French word. Thanks, ❤️ John P.S. I gotta mention our mid-month fundraising deadline, which is at midnight tonight. Your donation today gets you a sticker AND helps me reach our fundraising goal. | | Email us: info@johnfetterman.com

Clearly, we've got some enemies to the Constitution running our
country right now!

Peter Willis:
Just when you thought a collapsed stock

Grandpa Joe and Merrick Garland just took their dictatorial
mandates to a whole new level by turning the FBI in their own
political persecution squad!
You know, the same FBI that fell prey to the
"Steele Dossier" funded by Hillary Clinton.
Trump's own home was raided under the guise
of "classified data." Some in the Lamestream Media are claiming
Trump was hiding nuclear codes!
If you believe what the FBI is shoveling,
then I got some beachfront property in Arizona to sell you!
Listen, if we don't stop Pelosi and Biden
soon, we're not talking another 2 years of Dems holding on to
power - no, we're talking goodbye to the America we used to know!
Because if they can go after Trump and raid
his home, they sure as hell can come after you and me!
The only way we're going to stop Biden and
his cohorts is to take back Congress this November. With less
than 7 days before my primary, it's imperative you help me get
across the finish line with your $25, $50, or $100 donation today
and then defeat my Leftist Democrat incumbent this November.
My name is CPT. Robert M. Cornicelli, U.S.
Army (ret.). I served alongside America's bravest men and women
for over 20 years in the U.S. Navy and later in the U.S. Army
National Guard.
I understand what it means to fight for
freedom, and I empathize with those who put on the uniform to
serve our country and our communities. You can be assured I
didn't serve in the Army just to see career politicians like
Biden turn America into his own personal, banana republic!
I swore to uphold and defend the Constitution
from enemies foreign and domestic. Clearly, we've got some
enemies to the Constitution running our country right now!
Help me restore this country back to its
Constitutional foundations and end the radical left nightmare
harming our nation once and for all. Can I count on you to chip
in $50, $100, or $250 today to help me win next Tuesday?

CHIP IN $50

CHIP IN $100

CHIP IN $250

Look, with the way Biden and Pelosi are
tearing up the Constitution to pieces, it's not just enough to
have Congressmen with an "R" next to their name. We've already
got that with my RINO opponent, Andrew Garbarino. But you would
never believe it by the way he votes.
This is a man who is no better than RINOs Liz
Cheney or Adam Kinzinger. Andrew actually voted for Biden's
horrible inflation-causing legislation, which experts have laid
blame as a key cause for our inflation woes.
Garbarino even signed a letter PLEDGING HIS
SUPPORT TO WORK WITH BIDEN!
What good is a Red Wave this November if the
Republican is just as liberal as the Democrat incumbent?
That's why I desperately need you to chip in
$100, $500, $1,000, or whatever you can afford to help me win
next Tuesday and ensure a committed conservative is on the GOP
ticket this November.
There's too much at stake in the future of
our country for you to sit on the sidelines. At the rate Biden
and the Deep State are persecuting their political enemies, this
could be the last election you ever get to vote in… unless
you step up right now and help me win.
Will you donate at least $50 or more TODAY
and help me win out my primary next Tuesday?
I've been fighting to protect America my
whole life and now I'm ready to bring that fight to the Halls of
Congress, but only if you chip in today!
Save America,

CPT Robert M. Cornicelli, U.S. Army (ret.)
Republican for Congress, NY-02

I'm Tiffany Smiley. I know firsthand the sacrifice our veterans make for our great country.

Peter,

**I 'm Tiffany Smiley: Army wife, mother, nurse, and advocate. **

I know firsthand the sacrifice our veterans make for our great country. **T****oday, I 'm running for US Senate to fight for our veterans, and ensure they receive the care they deserve**- _the care they have earned._ | **[**FIGHT FOR OUR VETS**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61010838:6O9gxmVNs:m:1:3331421248:7C1CCC4575337B72CCF51BA27D978009:r)**
---

Back in April of 2005, while my husband Scotty was deployed in Iraq, I learned that he had been severely wounded by a suicide bomber, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both eyes.

I will never forget arriving at Walter Reed Medical Center and seeing my husband in that hospital bed. I knew at that very moment that I needed to put my nursing career aside and fight to ensure my husband received the care he deserved.

name: Harriet Hageman
subject: You and I don't have a moment to lose...
body:
This will be the most important race in the entire country... |
Peter,

Will you help me FIRE Liz Cheney and take back our conservative movement from the elitist establishment that is working arm-in-arm with Joe Biden?

No sooner had President Trump endorsed my primary challenge to Liz Cheney did she shoot back with her usual arrogance to "bring it."

[**Well, I'm counting on you to help me bring it by chipping in with an emergency donation to my campaign to FIRE Liz Cheney.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61014654:JsDpgmVN1:m:1:3253819041:17A7A2DB162102379A91B0006B86ABAA:r)
[DONATE NOW](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61014654:JsDpgmVN1:m:1:3253819041:17A7A2DB162102379A91B0006B86ABAA:r)
You and I don't have a moment to lose...

That's because establishment elitists, like George W. Bush, headline ritzy fundraisers in other states to raise millions for Cheney.

That was even after Cheney admitted in a 60 Minutes interview that her record-breaking fundraising haul was helped out by Democrats.

If there was ever a time for conservative Americans to stand up to the elitist establishment, it's now. And it's against Liz Cheney.

[**Will you help me stand up with an urgently needed donation today?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61014654:JsDpgmVN1:m:1:3253819041:17A7A2DB162102379A91B0006B86ABAA:r)

I'm getting ahead of myself.

Before you decide to give to my campaign to FIRE establishment-anointed Liz Cheney from Congress, **let me tell you a little about who I am, why President Trump endorsed my primary challenge, and why we need your immediate help.**

My name is Harriet Hageman, and Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his socialists hate - they run absolutely counter to the establishment elites who have for too long controlled our Republican Party... and sold out our country to the highest bidder.

**I should know - like many in my state, and many more around the country, I was duped by these same "Republicans."**

**And as a constitutional lawyer who fought against Bill Clinton's EPA regulations, I watched in disgust as establishment elites like Liz Cheney embraced big government and abandoned our conservative values.**

Unfortunately, it's only gotten worse since President Trump left office.

And now, backed by their friends on the left and the media, Cheney and the establishment are waging a full-blown war on Americans like you and me!

[**No more. Will you support my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney by making an emergency donation today? I'll be honest, her LIBERAL big money backers are putting millions of dollars into her campaign right. Without your help, I don't stand a chance.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61014654:JsDpgmVN1:m:1:3253819041:17A7A2DB162102379A91B0006B86ABAA:r)
[DONATE NOW](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61014654:JsDpgmVN1:m:1:3253819041:17A7A2DB162102379A91B0006B86ABAA:r)
As I said at the start of this email, **President Trump is 100% behind me.**

He knows the people of Wyoming - and the _American_ people - deserve better than Cheney, and he knows I'll never abandon our conservative values once elected to Congress.

In Wyoming, we have a long and proud history of standing up against an overbearing government.

In Washington, I promise to do the same...

...unlike Cheney, who spends more time fist-bumping Joe Biden and complimenting Nancy Pelosi than she does fighting back against big government bureaucrats who _waste our tax dollars_ , _fling open our borders_ , and _silence, censor, and even lock up conservatives_ who disagree!

**But even though I have President Trump's complete and total endorsement, there's one endorsement I still need: yours.**

[**Will you make an donation today to show President Trump that you're still a part of his MAGA-America First Movement?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61014654:JsDpgmVN1:m:1:3253819041:17A7A2DB162102379A91B0006B86ABAA:r)
[DONATE NOW](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61014654:JsDpgmVN1:m:1:3253819041:17A7A2DB162102379A91B0006B86ABAA:r)
You should know that, even though polls show Cheney is grossly unpopular in Wyoming, she still thinks she can win re-election.

**In fact, when liberal _60 Minutes_ asked her if she could beat me in the primary, she said "absolutely...this is going to be the most important House race in the country."**

Well, she was right about something - this will be the most important race in the entire country - but only because it will be the first step in saving America from the big government elites who enable Joe Biden.

Again, I'll need your help to beat her.

As I said, Cheney can count on the deep pocketbooks of the entire establishment.

That's not even saying anything for her left-wing supporters, who see this as their chance to weaken our Republican Party for good.

**But with your help, I know we can beat them. And I know we can send the disastrous Cheney political dynasty packing for good.**

[**So please, won't you ensure that Liz Cheney bury me, a true conservative, with money from her swampy elite friends?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61014654:JsDpgmVN1:m:1:3253819041:17A7A2DB162102379A91B0006B86ABAA:r)
[DONATE NOW](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61014654:JsDpgmVN1:m:1:3253819041:17A7A2DB162102379A91B0006B86ABAA:r)
Liz Cheney represents everything the left stands for, and everything we must fight against.

Will you help me make sure we win that fight?

Respectfully,
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61014654:JsDpgmVN1:m:1:3253819041:17A7A2DB162102379A91B0006B86ABAA:r)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

subject: Targeting Us All
body:
Fellow Conservative:

For the first time in American history, the FBI raided the home of a former president. This has never happened before, and it's a chilling example of political retribution.
What's worse is that this comes after Congress passed a budget reconciliation bill, which authorizes $80 billion for the IRS, including 80,000 new agents, to expand the agency's auditing power.
The Left isn't just targeting former President Trump; they are going to target all of us.
We here at CPI know what time it is. We know it's time to FIGHT back with real action, not just rhetoric.
Please stand and fight with CPI today!
If history has taught us anything, it is that conservatives can't win by default. We can't "play not to lose." We have to stand up and use every tool available to hold the Left accountable.
That's why CPI is working to build a new conservative movement that is up to the task now facing us. The organizations and projects we're supporting are unlike anything the Right or Left has ever seen:

| Dear Friends,
Did you have a chance to watch yesterday's debate between the candidates for Lieutenant Governor?
I'm all fired up about it, and I hope you are, too! If you haven't seen the video yet, take a look:
---
[](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001rD5bCDSFXCNWnOaf9uZNr33J75MNEDvNoWCQngC4OeeVNjIcO927jNTncOKrvn1aE_xA48TZPXZs8PGM71FavfIcg1PJ1CQByv6FpCzmdOpXDcxTbaFpnZk2ogb90w5NaHPfyXiVf_7lpncVAsXhFQ==&c=ujY5c4agNrUpncKngMinvWhSPZxx1eyxdA0xxvKy5WNXsRXMPvnoGQ==&ch=lQ-DgRXSeuY7rqEZqrDmoVITxOaZvp7HmWABWgC8WYEmLT0wDjx6UQ==)
---
---
| It was great to have the opportunity to explain my thoughts on some of the most important issues of the day. For example:
---
|
* to tell the story of how I lost my job as a nurse in the COVID ward of a local hospital due to vaccine mandates, and how it inspired me to run alongside Geoff Diehl. We are not anti-vaccine, but we are the only true anti-mandate candidates in this race.

* to reaffirm my belief that our entire nation has been in decline under the current administration in Washington, D.C., and how the policies of the previous administration were superior for families and businesses. I'm not backing down from that belief, and I'm not about to be told by my opponent that I can't win because of it. I can - and I will.

* to talk as a mom about the importance of family and education, including empowering parents, supporting school choice, and opposing unfair mandates and improper curriculum in schools.

* to express outrage that the Legislature is prioritizing their summer vacation over tax breaks for Massachusetts families, and to reaffirm my opposition to the ballot question for an income tax increase.

* to urge people to support the ballot question to repeal the law giving driver's licenses to illegal immigrants. Unlike our opponents, Geoff and I are still working hard to collect signatures before the deadline.

---
Geoff and I are fighting hard to protect you, your freedoms, your children, and your wallet. Are you with us? If so, we would greatly appreciate your support and your vote in the September 6 Republican primary. Thank you!
Sincerely,
---
Leah

[Remember my campaign jingle?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49301742/361618056/1375693006?refcode=EM_BS_GEL_220816_FR_STUMP_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YTgzZjY3OS03MDFkLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mcwf1QjbFxhy2y_wrtmwNVwH8oAeUJx9i4F7VIzumMY=) You might be asking — why would I launch my campaign with a parody of a sitcom jingle?

Here are three reasons why.

[#1 Authenticity](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49301744/361618058/1375693006?refcode=EM_BS_GEL_220816_FR_STUMP_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YTgzZjY3OS03MDFkLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mcwf1QjbFxhy2y_wrtmwNVwH8oAeUJx9i4F7VIzumMY=): Growing up, I was the chubby kid who figured out that telling jokes was a way to make friends and keep from being bullied.

At the University of Florida, I fell in love with Improv comedy. Improv comedy teaches you how to be present, listen, and collaborate — essential skills for being a representative in Congress.

And after college, I moved to Los Angeles and pursued acting. If you happen to be watching the Stanley Cup in 2010, you may have caught my star turn in a breathtaking Best Buy commercial.

[Comedy has always been my voice, my art, and the lens through which I see the world.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49301746/361618060/1375693006?refcode=EM_BS_GEL_220816_FR_STUMP_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YTgzZjY3OS03MDFkLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mcwf1QjbFxhy2y_wrtmwNVwH8oAeUJx9i4F7VIzumMY=)

It’s also how I came to the world of activism: I was ending my career as a comedian in Los Angeles when I first realized how I could combine comedy and politics.

I then went on to work at Upworthy, the DNC, and PrioritiesUSA. I was part of the team that helped win back the House in 2018 and know what it takes to win tough races.

How’d we do it? Creativity.

[And that’s #2: Creativity.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49301748/361618062/1375693006?refcode=EM_BS_GEL_220816_FR_STUMP_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YTgzZjY3OS03MDFkLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mcwf1QjbFxhy2y_wrtmwNVwH8oAeUJx9i4F7VIzumMY=) Our campaign is brave enough to do things creatively.

The old, losing playbook says you have to run the safest campaign possible to win. You have to ask the DC establishment for permission. That’s why we wind up with so many Democratic campaigns that look like they were grown in a DC lab.

Doing things differently means [ leaning more into who we are, not trying to follow some poll-tested idea](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49301750/361618064/1375693006?refcode=EM_BS_GEL_220816_FR_STUMP_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YTgzZjY3OS03MDFkLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mcwf1QjbFxhy2y_wrtmwNVwH8oAeUJx9i4F7VIzumMY=) of what a middle-of-the-road Democrat is supposed to look like.

I’m proud to talk about the climate crisis and how we need to tackle student debt. We must proudly stand with the LGBTQ+ community, defend marriage equality, and work to protect trans folks.

I think it’s time for new leaders to step up and make themselves heard in the halls of Congress.

Which brings me to [ Number 3: Electability](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49301753/361618066/1375693006?refcode=EM_BS_GEL_220816_FR_STUMP_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YTgzZjY3OS03MDFkLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mcwf1QjbFxhy2y_wrtmwNVwH8oAeUJx9i4F7VIzumMY=). Our campaign is the one that can win in November.

The Republican Party is off the rails. If their weapon is fear and anger and hopelessness, [ I’m coming armed with joy and optimism and a bit of creativity. ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49301754/361618070/1375693006?refcode=EM_BS_GEL_220816_FR_STUMP_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YTgzZjY3OS03MDFkLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mcwf1QjbFxhy2y_wrtmwNVwH8oAeUJx9i4F7VIzumMY=)

If we want to invite more people into the political process, we have to stop lecturing them and we have to find ways to be inviting. We are never going to beat Republicans by just trying to be more “nice” or giving them more facts.

So, why a jingle? [ Authenticity, creativity, electability.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49301755/361618071/1375693006?refcode=EM_BS_GEL_220816_FR_STUMP_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YTgzZjY3OS03MDFkLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mcwf1QjbFxhy2y_wrtmwNVwH8oAeUJx9i4F7VIzumMY=) That’s how we win.

[How do I know this is a winning combination?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49301756/361618072/1375693006?refcode=EM_BS_GEL_220816_FR_STUMP_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YTgzZjY3OS03MDFkLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mcwf1QjbFxhy2y_wrtmwNVwH8oAeUJx9i4F7VIzumMY=) We are the only campaign in this race to have raised over half a million dollars. We’re endorsed by leading progressive organizations like the Progressive Change Campaign Committee, the Democratic Progressive Caucus of Florida, the FL College Democrats, and more.

subject: Interpreting Sarah Palin’s ramblings for you today, our friend, David Pakman who tries to figure out what she meant to say at her CPAC appearance. If you don’t want to find out what at least 2 years of Rep. Sarah Palin will be like, click over and have a listen.
body:
Peltola vs. Palin
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, **Sarah Palin’s CPAC appearance was everything we’ve come to expect from her since she stumbled onto the national stage in 2008.** [**Our friend, David Pakman, breaks it down for you on The David Pakman Show, where she tried and failed to make a quote from Abraham Lincoln relevant to whatever it is she was trying to tell us she was mad about.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb218d3e4-0571-401e-9afb-bf26de6cec0e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Sarah Palin has run out of reality shows, cheap gimmicks and family values (her husband Todd divorced her a few years ago, accusing her of abuse), reentering a political system she helped debase in 2008 with her casual stupidity and endless conspiracies. [**Can you please join me in supporting Mary Peltola with $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford, and rejecting the hate and lies, once again, of Sarah Palin?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7a48cf91-136f-482a-813f-fb9caccb443b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **Palin's running for the vacant seat in Congress from Alaska. She was joined by Trump at a rally the very day Mar-a-Lago was raided, and put out the following crass, dishonest and riot-inciting statement (See FBI Building, Cincinnati) in response to the FBI raid to retrieve stolen state secrets----including some on nuclear technology--that Trump may have been selling to our enemies:** _If Palin wins the seat from Alaska, she'll have the large soapbox afforded her by her fame from which to attack our democracy and institutions, weakening the rule of law. It would be like taking Marjorie Taylor Greene or Lauren Boebert and injecting them with steroids. In a few words, Sarah Palin's uniquely dangerous._ Luckily we have a GREAT CHANCE to stop Palin and win this seat. Alaska has a top four primary and a ranked choice general election ballot. Native Alaskan and Democrat Mary Peltola is running for the seat, and if Democrats list her first, and she's listed second on enough ballots by independents and Republicans angry at the other Republicans for attacking their top choice, she can win!

| **Peltola is a Yupik Eskimo, who would bring a valuable perspective to Congress. She is also an incredible person, elected to the first of her four terms in the state legislature at the age of 24. She has made sustainability a key part of her life and platform by directing the Kuskokwim River Inter Tribal Fish Commission representing more than 30 tribes working to restore salmon returns to their traditional spawning grounds. ** _Almost any human walking this Earth would be a huge upgrade over Sarah Palin, but with Peltola, we can bring diversity to Congress, add a terrific legislator and reject a dangerous demagogue who has proven in the past she'll tell any lie, smear any opponent--even putting them in danger as when she said then Senator Obama "palled around with terrorists"\--to get what she wants. Palin is like an out-of-date, crappy reality show that was cancelled a decade ago. Let's not bring that back into our lives and politics. _ [**Can you please join me in supporting Mary Peltola with $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford, and rejecting the hate and lies, once again, of Sarah Palin?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4a908bf8-9c86-4802-9c11-ea19367bf07b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you for helping us stop Sarah Palin from gaining power yet again. Team,
Congress passing the most comprehensive environmental protection legislation in the last century is a huge accomplishment. That law will fight climate change and protect our planet for future generations while creating new jobs and economic opportunities.
It was only possible because Democrats hold control of Congress by a slim majority.
Now we need to ensure Democrats keep control of Congress so we can continue fighting to secure our economic and environmental future.
Securing our future also means promoting safety and opportunity. It’s time to create more high-paying jobs in our community, keep every resident safe from gun violence, and protect our civil rights and our democracy.
That’s exactly what I’ll do in Congress.
I know how to get this done. As a State Representative, I broke through decades of gridlock to pass the largest gun violence prevention, mental health, and school safety bill in Florida’s history.
Now, I’m ready to bring the fight for change to Washington – but I need your help.
Please remember to return your vote-by-mail ballot, vote early in-person, or vote on Election Day this August 23rd!
Thanks,
Jared

body:
This is an embarrassment

When I saw this post by the United States Marines, I almost threw my phone against the wall. [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61018144:JBGZryVNv:m:1:3331421248:30D0E80B576C5A839DF1C6F5C0B6A3A4:r) When I served our country as a combat physician in Iraq, I saw the brutality of war first hand. I witnessed the bravest young men in our country lose life and limb protecting our freedom. These Marines never backed down from a challenge, and they were willing to give their life to defend the liberties we have today. It was Ben Franklin who, when asked what form of government the constitutional convention had produced, said: “A republic, if you can keep it.”
Donald Trump’s election sealed the deal for me to retire after nearly 4 decades in the U.S. Navy. Having been in uniform for every President since Jimmy Carter, I showed my respect for Mr. Trump with my feet. I was done. It was apparent that the next four years would not go well.
Unfortunately, putting himself before his country culminated when Trump and his fellow Republicans planned, cajoled accomplices, then launched a domestic insurrection on the U.S. Capitol. Five lives were lost, and the nation’s innocence, as well. And it ain’t over.

body:
https://www.catherineforcongress.com [https://www.catherineforcongress.com]
Healthcare is a human right.
The COVID pandemic taught us a lot. Our healthcare system is vulnerable and patients, now more than ever, need access to quality health care without being burdened by medical bills. No one should have to choose between necessary medication, rent, or putting food on the table. Health care is a human right and we need to craft legislation that enshrines our health and wellness as a priority in this country, so we all can thrive.
That’s why Catherine supports universal health care access (Medicare for All), medical professionals, and patient protections by expanding the “Patient’s Bill of Rights” to be more inclusive of all no matter their zip code. Catherine is an ardent supporter of the Affordable Care Act, and she knows there’s an opportunity to do even more by bringing patients and doctors to the table to talk about how this vital service can better serve the health and wellness of all Americans.
We also need to destigmatize mental health. From our children struggling in the classroom, to preparing them to take on life’s greatest challenges, mental health needs to be front and center when we talk about fixing our healthcare system. And as adults, we need to continue that care with affordable access to professionals who can help give us the tools to overcome those challenges.
That’s why Catherine supported a ban on conversion therapy for minors, and just this year supported a new program through our Public Safety Department that focuses on mental health specialists as part of the 911 team.
Access to health care has been a generational struggle for Americans. Catherine has taken actionable steps to ensure affordable and equitable access to healthcare is available to NY-16 residents as a County Legislator. And now she wants to take that same determination to Congress.
Catherine is the only candidate in this race with the experience to work within her own party and across the aisle to deliver results for us.
And don’t forget to MAKE A PLAN TO VOTE! Early Voting has already begun!

subject: We must do more
body:
| |
---
Friend, Thanks to the Supreme Court overturning Roe v. Wade, we’re headed into one of the hardest moments in American history. **** When it comes to continued reproductive & civil liberties being eroded, being pro-choice is not enough. Women and people with reproductive organs in America need proactive leadership. I released a plan for Reproductive and Civil liberties in Vermont that will ensure the draconian Dobbs decision will support and build the freedom of Vermonters, while also doing our part for our fellow Americans. **** By having a Republican Governor who won’t be proactive to stop the further erosion if freedom for women and people with reproductive organs, we’re hurting people who live in red states and depend on Vermont to lead the way on liberty. **** Here are some concrete steps I will take as Governor to combat the Dobbs decision and protect women’s rights and liberties:
* Change Vermont extradition laws to protect abortion care providers, people seeking abortions from other states and those who support them
* Improve privacy laws to ensure that people who come to access abortion will have further protection
* Update our Fair and Impartial Policing policy to prevent cooperation between law enforcement and out of state agencies about reproductive or other civil liberties
* Create a state fund/support existing funds to supplement abortion care costs so that it does not show up on insurance bills and so that low income folks have access
* Build a coalition with nearby states to create a plan to protect people in the event of a federal ban on reproductive or any civil liberties
* Pass mandatory paid family and medical leave to support those experiencing pregnancy

Here are some concrete steps I will take as Governor to combat the Dobbs decision and protect women’s rights and liberties: Change Vermont extradition laws to protect abortion care providers, people seeking abortions from other states and those who support them Improve privacy laws to ensure that people who come to access abortion will have further protection Update our Fair and Impartial Policing policy to prevent cooperation between law enforcement and out of state agencies about reproductive or other civil liberties Create a state fund/support existing funds to supplement abortion care costs so that it does not show up on insurance bills and so that low income folks have access Build a coalition with nearby states to create a plan to protect people in the event of a federal ban on reproductive or any civil liberties * Pass mandatory paid family and medical leave to support those experiencing pregnancy I have a clear plan to protect the erosion of our civil liberties. Good enough is just not enough right now. We have to do better. I’m going to do everything possible to protect reproductive and civil liberties as Governor. We need leaders who will fight attacks on our reproductive and civil liberties with full force. We’ve got a real chance to make Vermont a safe haven for women and people with reproductive organs facing persecution, but we need your help winning the Governorship this fall. subject: Join my fight
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Andy's Fight Political Action Committee (FEC-1592063) and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/95557/images/AndysFightLogo.PNG][https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/95557/images/IMG_9106%20copy.jpeg]
Peter,
It's been a little while since you've heard from me and I wanted to let you know what I've been up to.
You know my story - seven years ago my 24-year-old daughter Alison was murdered by a crazed gunman while reporting the news on live tv. The video of her murder proliferated on social media and getting tech giants to take down the images and videos of this horrific tragedy proved to be impossible.
I decided to dedicate my life to taking on the flow of disinformation online and weapons of war offline. Sadly, both have only gotten worse in recent years. I began this year running for Congress to take on these fights, but I’ve changed course and am starting a PAC to help the candidates taking on these issues of life or death and to tell the truth about those who aren't . Here's the video I put out when we launched earlier this month.
You'll NEVER get an email from me that just asks for your money. What you WILL get in your inbox are regular updates on my effort to change policies, links to my weekly YouTube videos and commentaries about both Virginia and national politics. I'll also be highlighting candidates I think need your help in critical midterm races.
Andy's Fight is different from other gun-violence prevention groups, both in focus and tactics. Here’s what Andy’s Fight believes and will do:
a) Disinformation: Conspiracies and lies destroying our democracy and endangering us all. Platforms like Facebook not only don't try to stop it, but actively promote it for engagement. Current laws can help if enforced, but we also need new laws for a new age, ones that recognize like child porn and threats to the President’s life, incitement to violence and online stalking aren’t free speech, they’re dangerous and quell the very rights of speech, assembly and petition we must protect.
b) Life Saving Reform s: Andy’s Fight will not seek to put a band aid on a gaping wound. Yes, we absolutely need universal background checks and national red flag laws. Yet, while many other anti-gun violence groups stop there, Andy’s Fight won’t stop until we have a ban on assault weapons and high-capacity magazines. We will never put a stop to regular mass shootings and everyday street violence without these common-sense laws, ones that exist in nearly every other high-income democracy.
c) Aggressiveness : Andy’s Fight won’t play nice with Pat Toomey, Susan Collins or even Joe Manchin in the hope of bipartisan support for the measures we need. If you're failing to protect your constituents, we don’t care who likes you in Beltway circles, we’re going to tell people what you’re doing and how it is getting us killed.
The best way for your to help is to forward this email to your network and send a contribution on ActBlue [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/andy-s-fight-1?refcode2=13c68c88-851d-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a] .
If you believe, as I do, that it’s time for the gloves to come off, join our fight— Andy’s Fight —and together we’ll change America and save countless lives.
All my best,
Andy

Collinsville, VA 24078

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zmfjtofpo48gh5v55jap4mrubu88048djqs258a8_rp22sh2s8i66or0cdhm9o71cjh2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. Friend, Every politician loves to say that our “children are the future,” but many of them don’t back their words up with actions to help our children succeed. We must do better for our next generation. I’ve been a teacher for almost 25 years, and I am committed to delivering for our children. **** All children in the US need to have access to high-quality education, including preschool through post-secondary school. This will lead to a prepared, qualified, and advanced workforce filled with successful workers. Here’s what I’ll do for our children:
* Introduce federal subsidies for preschool and high-quality, affordable early childhood education.
* Reform Common Core standards to focus on educational outcomes while decentralizing the implementation of curriculum and emphasizing a reduction in testing.
* Reform and streamline student debt amnesty to 5 years of public service
* Create federal incentives for public universities to reduce operation administrative costs and increase year-to-year progression and completion rates

I’m running for Congress to get things done. As your representative, I will see that all of these ideas turn into realities by introducing and passing a “Workforce of Tomorrow” bill in to include all of these ideas and even more. Byron Donalds and the GOP have turned their backs on our children. They’ve refused to adequately fund the Department of Education and aid our local schools. body:
Every time something like this comes our way, Mark knows he can count on folks like you to step up and have his back.
#

Friends —
After 39 combat missions in Desert Storm, after commanding the space shuttle twice, and after staring down everything Trump could throw at him in 2020, Mark’s pretty hard to intimidate.
So, when Big Pharma said they’d come for him if he voted to let Medicare negotiate down the prices of prescription drugs, it was an easy choice.
He did it anyway.
He did it because it was the right thing to do. And now, American families stand to save as much as $300 billion on prescription drugs.
But Big Pharma is going to make good on their promise — they’ve said they’ll do whatever they can to punish Mark for his vote. That probably means millions of dollars in attack ads from Big Pharma in the weeks leading up to Election Day. And our only chance at fighting back is you.
Every time something like this has come our way, Mark has been able to count on folks like you to step up and have his back. And he needs you because right now we’re running well short of our August fundraising goals.
With pharmaceutical companies gearing up to come after Mark, we can’t risk being unprepared. So, we have to ask:
[**Can you please make your first online donation to Mark Kelly? body:
I wanted to take a moment to tell you about my roots
| | |
---
Friend, I wanted to take a moment to tell you about my roots.
I was born in Jacksonville, Florida in 1957, the youngest of seven children. My mother was a maid and my father was a janitor, and I'll be honest, money was tight at times. But still, that didn't stop my parents from working hard to give me the world.
This photo is from my first trip to Washington, D.C., so many years ago, when I visited the city on a class trip. The trip was expensive – more than I thought we could afford – but my dad took out an advance on his next paycheck so he could send me to the nation's capital.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49297902/361605599/1672908452?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3961-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOGE5YTViNy02YjFkLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_Op3G7iRI60ojzRuCF4wpkCSt9rNtB6iLIAI9NIfB9U=)
After this trip, _everything_ was different. I began to consider a career in service and, after graduating college (the first in my family to do so!), I made the decision to enter the police academy at a time when so few police officers were Black and female.
After a few years on the force in Orlando, I was elected as chief of police – the first woman _ever _to fill that rank on the OPD! I served as a law enforcement officer for nearly 30 years, and my work even allowed me to meet President Obama!
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49297905/361605601/1672908452?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3961-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOGE5YTViNy02YjFkLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_Op3G7iRI60ojzRuCF4wpkCSt9rNtB6iLIAI9NIfB9U=)
But after so many decades spent protecting and serving the people of Orlando, I knew that my career in service was nowhere near finished. That's when I decided to run for Congress in 2016 and succeeded in flipping my seat _blue._ Since then, I've proudly served as congresswoman for Florida's 10th Congressional District.

In case we haven’t met, my name is Yesli Vega. I’m running for Congress in Virginia’s 7th Congressional District. There’s no doubt that the last couple of years under the Biden Administration have been tough for Virginians and Americans everywhere.

And to top it off, these left-wing policies have entirely destroyed our economy - bringing prices and inflation to levels our country has not seen in decades.](http://links.yeslivegaforvirginia.com/u/click?_t=876a4969a9724ab8bc814d84bfee8268&_m=7072b74882b64edc8706196ca33d547b&_e=HdlTyu6YxgT3yf1rUfHE84WGXBfiEGs1isdjXU0Sp1PoD_nMNg1qNWtmTY9NJB2wQUwHx3K0HT9325MpWr2S4SIiDdogKkdoUmNnj2Sx8eWWdIOy9LPD9RO2GnsMu5RAry0VfhLVjz89VGySSb9QUZzGTSP4xFL-yOIYsbEYt-9lr5uSsS6zNQsuDFXQZAdZML10HClekWrUBV_DPmomI-EOVkC0lKeBWC7qGrQvWGDuw8QzNa-yi6w6W8ChzB51rFMpnXJHVxztu0RacWB1-lXS6JwGlEjphxsz8SkEGwdN5zGaKRLkHVHNM7d2EK2tqG20WQb_L8lywpig1CPR_KhbRfq3IDiDqZ9BVUqOANTSUAaKQ5qzIJmVuNpWHVaYnbeoYH-fNYzFtxmKty-zH_TYrwSEwPm0a8tnQV2wDrVQRf_ODzb1JJO3w0HkiH_0QYuLWORfkazrurbu6ZjDUNEbvvqjgAxqeHNjk9YEI3A%3D)**
_After my brother and his friend became victims of gang violence, I felt called to join law enforcement._ As I watched these noble men and women care for my family, I knew I had discovered the best way to give back to a country that had given so much to me.

In 2018, I decided to run for the Prince William County Board of Supervisors on a common-sense conservative platform. body:
Locals, join us tonight for a Meet & Greet Fundraiser event for Peggy Schiller, Congressional Candidate for CD-01. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/4959966a96d7/join-us-tuesday-peggy-schiller-meet-greet-fundraiser-9055426?e=9c22e4067b)
---
| | Hello Peter,

**Reminder: TONIGHT is the night! Join us!**

If you are local to the Panhandle area and would like the opportunity to meet a Democratic nominee for Congress, **Peggy Schiller,** please join us tonight for a Meet & Greet fundraiser event.

At this event hosted by Wade Gilliam and myself, you will** learn more about Peggy's qualifications, platform, and vision for the district. **

---
|
---
|
We will be at the **Black Bear Bread Bar Room** located at 26 Logan Lane, Unit H, in Santa Rosa Beach tonight starting** at 6:00PM.**

You will have the chance to ask Peggy questions, mingle with like-minded people, and enjoy light hors d'oeuvres.**I know Peggy would love the chance to meet those of you who live in the area. **

**The suggested donation to attend is $100.** If you are unable to make this event, please consider making a much-appreciated donation to the campaign.

---
| [Donate Today >](https://outlook.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5bfd640916a1b05d7592a2dd1&id=e92ee91038&e=9c22e4067b "Donate Today >")
---
| **Matt Gaetz needs to know that we intend to vote him out this November! **The First Congressional District deserves a representative who will put the needs of the district first and Peggy is just the person for the job.

I hope you'll join us this evening!

Thanks,
Karen
---

body:
The Inflation Reduction Act is a huge achievement. And we must continue to fight for more.
#
Peter,
When I voted to pass the Inflation Reduction Act last week, I had a few things on my mind.
I thought about how we negotiated for more than a year to pass this major bill containing core pieces of President Biden’s Build Back Better agenda. Our dogged progressive energy helped win historic investments to fight climate change, and important health care and tax reforms.
I thought about how this is a big win for the people, millions will see their energy, health care premium, and prescription drug costs go down. **I also thought about how much work we have left to do to pass more of our progressive priorities.** Affordable child care, Medicare and Medicaid expansion, measures to reduce poverty, major housing reforms — these are things we must keep fighting for. Right now, President Biden could take a whole slate of actions that expand worker power and overtime pay, reform the criminal justice system, and protect immigrants.
As we build our progressive power in Congress, we will continue building support for Medicare for All and a Green New Deal, too. We need bold, transformative change in this country, and we will win it, Peter.
There is so much left to fight for while we celebrate the milestone passage of the Inflation Reduction Act. Add your name to the commitment now.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/fight-on-2022/?source=em20220816-1520&t=3&akid=1520%2E420207%2E0KgwJO)

Pramila

disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Now that Congress passed the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act, we want to hear your gun violence prevention priorities
#

Friends -
Earlier this summer, Congress passed the most significant gun violence prevention legislation of its kind in nearly 30 years: the **Bipartisan Safer Communities Act.**
This legislation, signed into law by President Biden, is a gamechanger. It provides funding for community-based violence prevention initiatives and crisis intervention programs, creates a higher intensity background check program for individuals under 21 trying to purchase a gun, and enacts a stricter waiting period for people who have been convicted of domestic violence misdemeanors.
This critical step in the right direction is a win for our movement. It’s clear: our vision for a world with communities safer from gun violence is possible.
However, the work can’t stop here. While we’ve made progress, there is still so much more to be done to prevent all instances of gun violence in our country.
As we move forward in this new phase of our movement with renewed action from Congress, we want to know: **what are your top gun safety priorities?**
[**Please, take our August priorities survey today to share your thoughts with us:**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/august22-priorities-sv/?source=em220816-1-15&refcode2=2321.3935704.Ab5Sb_&akid=2321%2E3935704%2EAb5Sb_)
**[TAKE THE SURVEY](https://go.giffords.org/signup/august22-priorities-sv/?source=em220816-1-15&refcode2=2321.3935704.Ab5Sb_&akid=2321%2E3935704%2EAb5Sb_)**
Thank you for your participation. We appreciate reading your thoughtful responses as we refocus our priorities in the ever-changing fight against gun violence.
\- The team at Giffords PAC

Please let me explain why your contribution is so important to our campaign.
#

Friends -
I’m a lot like you: Every day I get emails like this from campaigns asking for my support.
I know it can be hard to see how one contribution could make a difference to a campaign like ours. That’s why I want to take a minute to explain why your $3 is so important today.
As you know, we’re up against an entrenched incumbent with corporate special interests on his side. He’s spent this campaign letting Trump-endorsing super PACs with six-figure checks1 speak for him; we’ve stayed true to our progressive values and relied on the contributions of regular folks like you to spread our message.
Now we only have ONE WEEK left to reach as many voters as we can with that message. Simply put, it’s now or never — and that’s why every dollar counts right now.
When you make your first $3 contribution, that money will immediately be put to work to reach voters across New York’s 17th district.
Whether it’s dialing numbers, sending mailers, or getting out in the field to knock doors, we can’t meet voters where they are without grassroots supporters like you who fuel our campaign.
So, I have to ask:
[**Can you please make your first $3 contribution before Election Day has come and gone? We need you if we are going to win this seat for the progressive movement.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/biaggi-em-aug22/?refcode=em220816-1-t1&refcode2=1022_59515_wv34Ei&akid=1022%2E59515%2Ewv34Ei)

| Dear Friend,
Please vote! Since Democrats created a 45-day election season, the first day of in-person voting begins September 23. And, of course, the final day to vote in the General Election is November 8, just 84 days away.
Inflation, open borders, fentanyl, life, our Second Amendment, and more are on the ballot this November. Much more important than me, at this point in time, is getting Bob Good, Yesli Vega, Rob Wittman, and the rest of our congressional delegation elected this November. Yes, I am running for State Senate, but we can worry about that more after November. Please pray, vote, volunteer, and help spread the word so that we can win back Congress and stop the Biden White House. I'm working on legislation for 2023. Please email your ideas to: [john@mcguireforvirginia.com](mailto:john@mcguireforvirginia.com)

Christian Conservative (Father - Navy SEAL - Business Owner) | Dear Friend, Please vote! Since Democrats created a 45-day election season, the first day of in-person voting begins September 23. And, of course, the final day to vote in the General Election is November 8, just 84 days away. Inflation, open borders, fentanyl, life, our Second Amendment, and more are on the ballot this November. Much more important than me, at this point in time, is getting Bob Good, Yesli Vega, Rob Wittman, and the rest of our congressional delegation elected this November. Yes, I am running for State Senate, but we can worry about that more after November. Please pray, vote, volunteer, and help spread the word so that we can win back Congress and stop the Biden White House. I'm working on legislation for 2023. Please email your ideas to: mailto:john@mcguireforvirginia.com Here are a few upcoming events and some of the things on my mind, and what I've been up to around the district: | 2000 Mules Powhatan County | | We will show the movie, "2000 Mules", in Powhatan County on Thursday, August 18, at 7pm, at Powhatan High School, 1800 Judes Ferry Rd, Powhatan, VA 23139. Put the word, "Powhatan", in the email subject line. Please bring family and friends. RSVP to john@mcguireforvirginia.com | Meet Congressman Rob Wittman and Yesli Vega | == | We hope to see you on August 21 at the poolside, "BBQ on the James", sponsorship dinner for the Family Foundation of Virginia's Action Team, with special guest speakers Congressman Rob Wittman, Yesli Vega, Bishop E.W. Jackson, and Becky Norton Dunlop, the Special Assistant of President Ronald Reagan and Director of his Cabinet office. == for details and to RSVP. | Powhatan Shrimp Feast 2020 | == | Please tell friends about the Powhatan Shrimp Feast on August 27th, from 4-8 PM. We hope to see you then. Click here for details == | Goochland Constitution Day Picnic | | Please join the == and other fellow patriots on Saturday, September 17, for a free event, 11am to 3pm. This will be a celebration of our 235th year of the adoption of the United States Constitution, and of those who have become U.S. citizens. This event will take place at 30 Broad Street Road, Manakin Sabot, Va. They will have BBQ, chicken, cole slaw, and more. They will hand out Constitution booklets, have games, face painting for kids, and give out quizzes. There will be several guest speakers discussing the U.S. Constitution. This will be fun for the whole family. Please spread the word! | Spirit of Virginia Reception | | | | | | | | How many of you are happy to have a Republican governor? In just six months Governor Glenn Youngkin has given Virginians over $4 billion in tax relief, fired the parole board as promised, funded our police, increased school choice, returned our children back to school without a mask, and much more. Tracy and I met some wonderful people at the "Spirit of Virginia" reception, along with fellow Delegates Scott Wyatt, Mike Cherry, and Kim Taylor. I'm running for State Senate so we can "un-California" Virginia. Thank you, Governor Youngkin, for the mention. | National Rifle Association of America Banquet | | | | I ran into Senator Amanda Chase at the NRA's "National Rifle Association of America" banquet. We met many patriots concerned about our Second Amendment rights and our Republic. Stay vigilant and get friends to vote in November! | More Outrageous Cancel Culture | == | Can you believe the Virginia State Board of Education will consider more anti-American "woke" ideas this week? "...Two of the proposed changes to Virginia's history and social science standards of learning tests would eliminate calling George Washington the "Father of our Country" and James Madison the "Father of the Constitution." This is one of the items the new Virginia Board of Education is expected to discuss this week in Richmond." == for the article. | Vicky Harte, Louisa County | | I really appreciate the "Stop Louisa Flooding" group and Vicky Harte, a Louisa resident, for informing me of the "man made" flood problems they are experiencing in Louisa County caused by. I spoke with the Louisa County Administrator and we found out that the county and town have formed a work group and they are looking at potential solutions. They will keep me informed on progress. | Virginia National Guard Annual Training Visit | | It was an honor to attend the Virginia National Guard Annual Training Visit for legislators, with fellow Delegate Scott Wyatt of Hanover. By the way, Scott is a pretty good shot with the M4 rifle and the new Sig Sauer M17 Army Pistol (a customized version of SIG Sauer's P320). To all of our men and women serving in our military, thank you for all you do to keep us safe! | Support Trump Rally | | | | | | The raid on President Trump's home in Mar-a-Lago is outrageous and unprecedented. American's trust in our government continues to weaken, due to many examples of a double standard. Thank you, to so many of you, who came out to support Trump; and to all our speakers, including National Committee Woman Patti Lyman, Congressman Bob Good, Senator Amanda Chase, President VAHDA Kirby Burch, VCDL Founder Paul Moog, and others who spoke against politicizing government agencies and the importance of voting Republican this November. | National Night Out Goochland County | | | | | | It was great to see our friends, Commonwealth Attorney Mike Caudill, Sheriff Stephen Creasy, many deputies, other elected officials, and about 450 citizens at "National Night Out Goochland", in support of our men and women who keep us safe. The goal is to heighten crime-prevention awareness, build support and participation in local anti-crime programs, and most importantly, send a message that our neighborhoods are organized and fighting back. It's also the perfect opportunity to get to know your neighbors better. To our men and women in law enforcement, thank you for keeping us safe! | Goochland County's Newest Bloodhound, Liberty | | The Goochland Sheriff's department has a new bloodhound, Liberty. Liberty will add another aspect to the Goochland Sheriff's department with helping to find missing people. | National Night Out Louisa County | | | | | | | Thank you to our law enforcement officials in Louisa County for keeping us safe. I caught the beginning of "National Night Out" in Louisa County during a torrential downpour, which cleared up just for a few moments before I had to leave. | Prayer Before the Game, Amelia County! | | Prayer before the game! Thank you so much, to all who donated to support Amelia County's Boys Baseball team, who attended the 2022 Dixie Youth Baseball Division II World Series in Anderson, South Carolina. Amelia Dixie League Majors All Stars won the 2022 World Series Championship undefeated 5-0. All of the teams were competitive and brought a lot of talent. Amelia stayed focused and played as a strong team, with a lot of support from the crowd. You may remember, if you subscribe to my newsletter, that these boys were doing a car wash fundraiser and posed for a photo with my truck. Thanks to you, they raised enough money to send the team to South Carolina. Congratulations! | We must NEVER FORGET. | | | | On August 6th we honored and remembered thirty Americans, and one military working dog, who were all killed on August 6th, 2011, when their U.S. Army CH-47D Chinook, call sign "Extortion 17", was shot down by Taliban fighters south of Kabul, Afghanistan. On that day, the United States sustained the greatest single loss of lives to our Special Operations Forces in American history. The resulting crash killed all 38 people on board, including 17 U.S. Navy SEALs, two United States Air Force Pararescue, one United States Air Force Combat Control Team member, one pilot and two crewmen of the United States Army Reserve, one pilot and one crewman of the United States Army National Guard, seven members of the Afghan National Security Forces, one Afghan interpreter, as well as a U.S. military working dog. Join us as we honor those who have been given a Purple Heart. #thankyou #usa | Hanover GOP committee meeting. | | | | | | Congressman Bob Good gave us a campaign update at the Hanover GOP committee meeting. | Dan is focused on lowering costs for America’s working families.

From gas to groceries to prescription drugs, he is committed to making life more affordable for every American. That’s why he led efforts to stand up to Big Pharma and just passed a new law to allow Medicare to negotiate drug prices, which will lower prescription drug costs for everyone on Medicare and private insurance. Dan also passed a new law capping the out-of-pocket costs that seniors will pay for prescription drugs to $2,000 per year.

| | **Friend, above all else, I am and will forever be a parent first.** My three kids are well into their adult years, but I still think about them every minute of every day. As a mother, I _always_ worry about their safety — especially right now. There hasn’t been a **single week** in 2022 without a mass shooting. Our schools, our grocery stores, _even our holiday parades_ are not safe from the gun violence epidemic spreading throughout our country. _Enough is enough._ It’s time to enact common-sense gun laws and condemn the permitless carry bills legislators like my opponent have tried to pass. It’s time to enact background checks and red flag laws, and it’s time to stop sending wishes for peace without any meaningful course of action. **[If you’re ready to join my fight to enact common-sense gun reform, sign my petition today so we can send D.C. the message: Our communities need action, not empty platitudes.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49306537/361636499/1715611728?refcode=em_220816_guncontrol_rs&sourceid=1031507&ms=em_220816_guncontrol_rs&refcode2=a47b474c-781d-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDdiNDc0Yy03ODFkLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mWMgAqA2bLJwaqCBiaS9u-QHq3X-XlXZxxh6lQrQ76Y=&emci=21f116df-d81c-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=a47b474c-781d-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=17998091)** | [SIGN ON »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49306538/361636502/1715611728?refcode=em_220816_guncontrol_rs&sourceid=1031507&ms=em_220816_guncontrol_rs&refcode2=a47b474c-781d-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDdiNDc0Yy03ODFkLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mWMgAqA2bLJwaqCBiaS9u-QHq3X-XlXZxxh6lQrQ76Y=&emci=21f116df-d81c-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=a47b474c-781d-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=17998091)

My three kids are well into their adult years, but I still think about them every minute of every day. As a mother, I always worry about their safety — especially right now. There hasn’t been a single week in 2022 without a mass shooting. Our schools, our grocery stores, even our holiday parades are not safe from the gun violence epidemic spreading throughout our country. Enough is enough. It’s time to enact common-sense gun laws and condemn the permitless carry bills legislators like my opponent have tried to pass. It’s time to enact background checks and red flag laws, and it’s time to stop sending wishes for peace without any meaningful course of action. | Our children — and our communities — deserve leadership who cares more about their safety than their rating from the NRA. My opponent just started airing extremely negative attacks against me, so needless to say,I could really use your immediate help to make sure that the lies she’s peddling against me do not go unanswered. When I say that my campaign is dependent on supporters like you to keep our ads on TV, I mean it. I really would not be in the strong position I am in today without your generosity. We’re almost to finish line. Let’s get this done. Alek Skarlatos Republican for Congress | Alek is a former Oregon National Guardsman, completing a nine-month deployment in Afghanistan. body:
Do you remember President Dewey? I don't either.
| | |
---
Peter, do you remember President Dewey? I don't either — that's because Thomas Dewey never became president. (I know this is starting to sound like a history lesson, but just bear with me for a minute here.)
You see, way back in 1948, the GOP and all the pundits were 100% sure that Dewey was going to beat Harry Truman and win the presidential election. In fact, they were so certain of it, that newspapers went ahead and printed Dewey's victory in the next day's edition!!
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49326296/361693802/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk228-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYWMzMjJiNi05ZTFkLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=z0PZqG-G0pcNEvHbRTfesDxbpkZGJ6uw6HskQ7OUSBc=)
**But against all the odds and what all the so-called "experts" were saying, Harry Truman, a proud Missourian, defeated Dewey and became our 33rd president.**
When I hear DC insiders write off our state as MAGA territory, I remember Truman — how he stuck to his values, put in the work, and proved the naysayers wrong. Our election this November is not the first time that political elites have underestimated leaders from Missouri. And 1948 won't be the last time that Missourians prove the GOP wrong at the ballot box.
Just like Truman, I am dedicated to making sure that everyone has access to a great education, safe and affordable housing, and quality healthcare. **And just like Truman, I am ready to beat all the odds and win this thing in November.**
**But Truman didn't win in 1948 all by himself, and I won't win in 2022 if I don't have grassroots folks like you standing with me.[So please, if you're ready to prove the pundits and the GOP wrong in November, will you pitch in with a donation right now? I believe in this campaign, and I believe in the people of Missouri. This is a victory for Coloradans and for the American people over corporate special interests and the status quo. The bill will lower costs for families at the pharmacy, at the gas pump, and on their monthly energy bills and health insurance premiums. And now, we’re one step closer to energy independence and leading the fight against climate change. Here’s what the IRA will do:
* **_Lower prescription drug and health care costs_** , by allowing Medicare to negotiate drug prices — and cap prescription drug costs for seniors at $2,000 a year. Julie from Denver told me that her dad has a heart condition, and he pays $6,000 a month for medication — that’s $72,000 a year for something he needs to take for the rest of his life. That’s outrageous and ends with this bill.
* **_Build a fairer tax code_** by making sure the 200 biggest corporations that report over $1 billion in profit pay their fair share. Colorado teachers, firefighters and police officers shouldn’t be paying more in taxes than Amazon. It’s no wonder most Americans think our tax code is rigged. This comes directly from a bill I helped write.
* **_Make a historic investment in climate and clean energy_** — that includes funding to address droughts in the West and the Colorado River Basin and restore the health of our forests and prevent wildfires. It will boost American manufacturing for wind, solar, and batteries to power electric vehicles and our energy grid. When you put it all together, this bill will put us on track to reduce emissions by 40% by the end of the decade.

For decades, Washington’s economic agenda has been pretty simple: Let the big corporations do whatever they want and call it “freedom;” slash investments in working families, and cut taxes for the wealthiest individuals. That left us with income inequality higher than any time since the 1920s and a country that charges families more for health care than most industrialized nations — where seniors are forced to cut their pills in half or skip their prescriptions. We’re left with a nation that is still shackled to a global fossil fuel market dictated by tyrants like Vladimir Putin, despite our abundant resources at home and the urgent threat of climate change. **Today, we've shown that government can deliver for working people, not just the wealthy and big corporations.** I’m more hopeful than ever that we can leave Colorado and our country better for the next generation and build an economy that grows for everyone. Sincerely, Michael P.S. Not a single GOP Senator voted for the _Inflation Reduction Act_ , but thanks to supporters pitching in during critical moments, Democrats had the slim majority to pass this law. body:
They bowed down to Big Pharma, Peter. | | | Hi Peter – Republicans bowed down to Big Pharma last week, and in the process, failed our healthcare system. Diabetes is around 17% higher in rural areas than urban areas, and about 1 in 10 Americans (37.3 million people) have the disease. **Republicans voted against helping those Americans** , especially people in rural areas who already struggle with access to quality healthcare and food availability. Democrats proposed a $35/month cap on out-of-pocket spending on insulin for patients with private health insurance. Dozens of Republicans, including Sens. clean_body: They bowed down to Big Pharma, Peter. | | | Hi Peter – Republicans bowed down to Big Pharma last week, and in the process, failed our healthcare system. Diabetes is around 17% higher in rural areas than urban areas, and about 1 in 10 Americans (37.3 million people) have the disease. Republicans voted against helping those Americans , especially people in rural areas who already struggle with access to quality healthcare and food availability. Democrats proposed a $35/month cap on out-of-pocket spending on insulin for patients with private health insurance. Dozens of Republicans, including Sens. | | Friend, **Today, President Biden signed the Inflation Reduction Act into law, marking a major legislative victory that delivers on promises made to younger generations.** With your help, we fought alongside a powerful, multi-generational coalition to demand climate action and relief for working families. As congressional negotiations continued for well over a year, we didn’t let momentary setbacks deter us from fighting for what’s right. That hard work and determination paid off. Despite their best efforts, corporate interests and big polluters couldn’t beat us. Even without support from a single Republican in Congress, we passed the most significant climate legislation in U.S. history. That’s the power of youth organizing. [Take action: Join us in fighting for change by signing up to volunteer with us.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49326762/361696529/1905159732?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmM2E3MDkxZS1hMDFkLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rOCSlrKRjak-bsk6R_--LNcLtMIgoFTsde7s2RQxVjY=&emci=91a20581-871d-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=f3a7091e-a01d-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=6787172) President Biden and Democratic leaders in Congress have delivered a major accomplishment for the American people despite relentless obstruction by Republican politicians. They listened to our voices and achieved what many thought was impossible. **The Inflation Reduction Act will:**
* Make the largest investment in climate action in U.S. history;
* Put our nation on track to cut 40% of greenhouse gas emissions by 2030;
* Create 9 million good-paying clean energy jobs;
* Reduce energy bills for working families across the country;
* Lower health care premiums and prescription drug costs for million of Americans;
* Ensure the wealthiest corporations pay their fair share

This moment is the culmination of many years of work across the movement — and it wouldn’t have been possible without activists, volunteers, and voters from every corner of this nation. After decades of inaction, pressure from young people was crucial to get this historic legislation across the finish line. But we know that this is only the beginning, and more must be done to address the needs of frontline communities, working families, and future generations. Rest assured, we’re just getting started — **but we need your help.** | [Join our growing movement](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49326764/361696530/-1583238510?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmM2E3MDkxZS1hMDFkLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rOCSlrKRjak-bsk6R_--LNcLtMIgoFTsde7s2RQxVjY=&emci=91a20581-871d-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=f3a7091e-a01d-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=6787172 "CTA Button")
